senses.gloss:
gocāra
(‘movement of the प्लनेत्स्’)
------------------------------------------
Hindu अस्त्रोलोग्य् recognises nine प्लनेत्स् which exercise a great influence on the life of the human beings, both at the individual and at the social levels. These are: Ravi (Sun), चन्द्र or सोम (Moon), मङ्गल or कुज (Mars), बुध (Mercury), गुरु or बृहस्पति (Jupiter), शुक्र (Venus), शनि (Saturn), राहु and केतु (lunar nodes). These प्लनेत्स् produce good or bad effects depending on their position on the day in the zodiac, relative to the राशि (zodiacal sign like Meṣa or Aries). The राशि is that sign of the Zodiac where the मोओन् was present on the day of the birth of the person.
Gocāra is the technical name given to the movement of these nine प्लनेत्स्, starting with the राशि of the birth of the person, in the eleven succeeding positions. These movements—depending upon the particular planet and its position—give good or bad or mixed results.
For instance when Ravi (Sun) is in the राशि of birth, he will bring about disease. When सोम (Moon) is occupying the ninth होउसे from the राशि of birth, quarrels arise in one’s life. If गुरु (Jupiter) is occupying the eighth होउसे, he causes loss of wealth. If शुक्र (Venus) is in the third होउसे, he will bestow happiness. If शनि (Saturn) is occupying the sixth होउसे, wealth is gained.
The duration of stay of these प्लनेत्स् in each of the rāśis has been calculated by the astrological works. They are as follows:
Ravi (Sun) one month
Candra or सोम(Moon) one day
Kuja (Mars) two and a half months
Budha (Mercury) one month
Bṛhaspati or गुरु(Jupiter) twelve months
Śukra (Venus) one month
Śani (Saturn) thirty months
Rāhu and Ketu twenty months

The details of the effects of the प्लनेत्स् on one’s life, on a particular day, can be known by consulting an almanac and the tables given in Hindu astronomical texts.
See also JYOTIṢA.
